name: @latticekit/example-builder
description: BUILDER — a gallery exhibit. Placement: footprints, a ghost, validity, and the tap-to-tile seam.
$comment: Six of nine, and the two that matter are `iso` and `input` meeting at one seam — the pixel a finger landed on becoming the tile a footprint is tested against. `sim`, `persist` and `audio` are absent because a yard with no economy, no save and no sound is the smallest thing that shows that seam.
